description.value: Kosoo Cardero is a modern Korean restaurant operating in downtown Vancouver since 2015, blending traditional Korean flavors with contemporary techniques in a spacious, contemporary dining room. The creative menu spans Korean BBQ, gimbap, noodles, hot pots, and fusion items like kimchi gnocchi and Korean poutine. It is one of three Kosoo locations in the Vancouver area, with the Cardero branch positioned near Stanley Park in the West End.
